title: App surface is not implemented
body:
The application package must be importable as `app`, and must expose `app.main.create_app() -> FastAPI`, `app.db.init_db()`, `app.db.get_sessionmaker()`, `app.db.reset_engine()`, `app.seed.seed_sample_data(session)`, and the SQLAlchemy model `app.models.User` (with column `hashed_password`).

The app implements secure user authentication using JWT, hashes passwords with bcrypt, and supports role management with at least two roles (`admin` and `user`) that gate protected endpoints. The user model stores the bcrypt digest in a column named `hashed_password`.

Request/response models are declared with Pydantic, and persistence uses SQLAlchemy or Tortoise ORM consistently across the app.

Charts are rendered with Chart.js loaded from a vendored static asset. Vendor Chart.js at the on-disk path `app/static/chart.min.js`, serve it from the URL `/static/chart.min.js`, and reference it from the dashboard HTML at `/`. The HTML served at `/` must not contain the substring `cdn` anywhere, case-insensitive.
acceptance_hint: 7 executable checks over the app_surface surface.
